ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white primary surface area with approximately 35-40% coverage by low-intensity black pixel clusters, creating a high-contrast speckled distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of small, contiguous circular and sub-circular dark blobs across both lobes; larger solid black segments located at the distal tips and proximal regions near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 55 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels; serration is most pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct concave curve from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-sloping points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Global density of circular high-contrast rings (dark perimeter with light centers) consistent with barnacle scar topography distributed across 80% of the visible ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple dark, non-parallel linear streaks; notably two prominent diagonal rakes on the left lobe and one vertical streak on the right lobe cutting through the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy three-dimensional encrustations (barnacle clusters) visible at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, disrupting the clean geometric boundary of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: The density of circular 'rosette' scarring is exceptionally high, creating a 'leopard-spot' texture that is distinctive across the entire macro-structure.
